## Summary
Implement the UMLS full resolution step that takes a confirmed SubConcept, resolves it against the UMLS Metathesaurus API, creates or matches a StandardTerm node in Neo4j, and creates the GROUNDED_IN edge from SubConcept → StandardTerm.

## User story
As a curriculum architect, I want SubConcepts linked to standardized UMLS terms, so that cross-institutional concept alignment and USMLE mapping are grounded in canonical medical vocabulary.

## Why this matters
Without UMLS resolution, SubConcepts remain informal text labels with no standardized identity. This blocks: (1) anatomy/disease routing (S03 needs semantic_type), (2) HetioNet import (S04 needs CUI), (3) LOD brief generation (S05 needs grounded facts), and (4) cross-lecture deduplication (S06 needs SAME_AS via CUI match). An incorrectly resolved CUI propagates errors across the entire enrichment pipeline.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] UMLS REST API called with SubConcept name, returns top candidate CUIs
- [ ] Best CUI selected by semantic_type match + string similarity score
- [ ] StandardTerm node created in Neo4j: `{ cui, preferred_name, semantic_type, source_vocab, institution_id }`
- [ ] GROUNDED_IN edge created: SubConcept → StandardTerm (Rule 10: only this direction)
- [ ] Evidence grade on related TEACHES edges upgraded from C (0.65) to B (0.82) post-UMLS verification (Rule 9)
- [ ] Supabase `subconcepts` row updated: `umls_cui`, `umls_resolved_at`, `neo4j_sync_status`
- [ ] Supabase written FIRST, Neo4j SECOND (Rule 6)
- [ ] UMLS API throttled at 20 requests/second (Inngest throttle)
- [ ] Graceful handling: if UMLS returns no match, SubConcept flagged `umls_unresolved` (not failed)

## Canonical decisions in play
| Rule | What it means for this story |
|---|---|
| Rule 1 (C05) | neo4jQuery for StandardTerm creation + GROUNDED_IN edge — wrapper injects institution_id |
| Rule 6 (G08) | Write Supabase subconcepts row FIRST (umls_cui, resolved_at), then Neo4j StandardTerm + edge |
| Rule 9 | Upgrade TEACHES evidence_grade to B (0.82) after UMLS verification — import EVIDENCE_GRADE_WEIGHT |
| Rule 10 (D03) | GROUNDED_IN only SubConcept → StandardTerm — never AssessmentItem or Lecture |
| AP-14 | Use createSameAsIfSafe() if two SubConcepts resolve to same CUI — cycle prevention |

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// Pattern: UMLS resolution with Supabase-first dual-write
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client';
import { createServerClient } from '@journey/db/server';
import { EVIDENCE_GRADE_WEIGHT } from '@journey/types/constants';

export async function umlsResolve(subconcept_id: string, institution_id: string) {
  const supabase = createServerClient();

  // 1. Fetch SubConcept name from Supabase
  const { data: sc } = await supabase
    .from('subconcepts')
    .select('name, umls_cui')
    .eq('id', subconcept_id)
    .single();

  // 2. Call UMLS API (throttled by Inngest at 20/s)
  const umlsResult = await searchUmls(sc.name);

  // 3. Supabase FIRST (Rule 6)
  await supabase
    .from('subconcepts')
    .update({
      umls_cui: umlsResult.cui,
      umls_resolved_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      neo4j_sync_status: 'pending',
    })
    .eq('id', subconcept_id);

  // 4. Neo4j SECOND (Rule 1 — neo4jQuery wrapper)
  await neo4jQuery(
    `MERGE (st:StandardTerm {cui: $cui, institution_id: $institution_id})
     ON CREATE SET st.preferred_name = $preferred_name,
                   st.semantic_type = $semantic_type,
                   st.source_vocab = $source_vocab
     WITH st
     MATCH (sc:SubConcept {uuid: $subconcept_id, institution_id: $institution_id})
     MERGE (sc)-[:GROUNDED_IN {evidence_grade: 'B', evidence_weight: $weight}]->(st)`,
    {
      cui: umlsResult.cui,
      institution_id,
      preferred_name: umlsResult.preferredName,
      semantic_type: umlsResult.semanticType,
      source_vocab: umlsResult.sourceVocab,
      subconcept_id,
      weight: EVIDENCE_GRADE_WEIGHT.B, // 0.82
    }
  );

  // 5. Upgrade TEACHES edges to B (Rule 9)
  await neo4jQuery(
    `MATCH (cc:ContentChunk)-[t:TEACHES]->(sc:SubConcept {uuid: $subconcept_id})
     SET t.evidence_grade = 'B', t.evidence_weight = $weight`,
    { subconcept_id, weight: EVIDENCE_GRADE_WEIGHT.B }
  );
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import { driver } from 'neo4j-driver'; // BANNED — use neo4jQuery

// ✗ AP-06: GROUNDED_IN on wrong node type (Rule 10)
MERGE (ai:AssessmentItem)-[:GROUNDED_IN]->(st:StandardTerm) // BANNED — use SOURCED_FROM

// ✗ AP-14: SAME_AS without cycle check
MERGE (sc1)-[:SAME_AS]->(sc2) // BANNED — use createSameAsIfSafe()

// ✗ Rule 6 violation: Neo4j before Supabase
await neo4jQuery(...); // WRONG — Supabase must be written first
await supabase.from('subconcepts').update(...);
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. No SQL migrations to reverse (columns exist from E03)
2. Neo4j: `MATCH (st:StandardTerm) WHERE st.created_by_step = 'p2-umls-resolve' DETACH DELETE st`
3. Supabase: `UPDATE subconcepts SET umls_cui = NULL, umls_resolved_at = NULL WHERE umls_resolved_at > '[timestamp]'`
4. git stash && git checkout develop
